import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD_A = 998244353L;
    static final long MOD_B = 1000000007L;

    static long total_n;
    static List<Integer>[] buckets_arr = new ArrayList[10];
    static long[] prefix_sum_arr = new long[10];
    static long total_cnt1 = 0, total_cnt2 = 0, total_ans = 0;
    static int[] power_array = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000};

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            buckets_arr[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static long get_input_value(BufferedReader br) throws IOException {
        long val = 0;
        int sign_flag = 1;
        int c;
        while (true) {
            c = br.read();
            if (c == -1) break;
            if (c == '-') {
                sign_flag = -1;
                break;
            }
            if (Character.isDigit(c)) {
                val = c - '0';
                break;
            }
        }
        while (true) {
            c = br.read();
            if (c == -1 || !Character.isDigit(c)) break;
            val = (val << 1) + (val << 3) + (c - '0');
        }
        return val * sign_flag;
    }

    static void generate_combinations(int length, long value) {
        if (length > 6) return;
        buckets_arr[length].add((int)((total_cnt1 - value + MOD_A) % MOD_A));
        prefix_sum_arr[length] += (total_cnt1 - value + MOD_A) % MOD_A;
        total_cnt1++;
        for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; digit++) {
            generate_combinations(length + 1, value * 10 + digit);
        }
    }

    static boolean check_range(long x) {
        return x * 1000000 + 999999 <= total_n && x * 10000000 > total_n;
    }

    static void explore(int length, long value) {
        if (value > total_n) return;
        if (check_range(value)) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                long v1 = ((total_cnt2 + 1 - value * power_array[i]) % MOD_A + MOD_A) % MOD_A;
                int idx = lowerBound(buckets_arr[i], (int)(MOD_A - v1));
                long sum = prefix_sum_arr[i] + (long)buckets_arr[i].size() * v1 - (long)MOD_A * (buckets_arr[i].size() - idx);
                total_ans = (total_ans + sum) % MOD_B;
            }
            total_cnt2 += total_cnt1;
        } else {
            if (length != 0) {
                total_cnt2++;
            }
            total_ans = (total_ans + ((total_cnt2 - value) % MOD_A + MOD_A) % MOD_A) % MOD_B;
            for (int digit = (length == 0 ? 1 : 0); digit <= 9; digit++) {
                explore(length + 1, value * 10 + digit);
            }
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int target) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= target) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        total_n = get_input_value(br);
        generate_combinations(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(buckets_arr[i]);
        }
        explore(0, 0);
        System.out.println(total_ans);
    }
}
